description: Search StackTheDeal's live deals by keyword(s) — matched against deal titles, summaries, store and category. Use for questions like 'find me a deal on a coffee maker' or 'any LEGO deals?'. Optional filters narrow the matches: store (exact name), category, max_price (dollars), min_discount_pct. Sorting: pass sort — 'price_asc' returns the cheapest matches first (use it when the user asks for the cheapest), 'price_desc' priciest first, 'discount_desc' biggest percent off first; the default is 'relevance'. Results are StackTheDeal's verified site deals; each result links to its deal's page on stackthedeal.com only (results link to our pages only — the retailer's link lives on that page). Travel searches (flights, hotels, car rentals, airport transfers, eSIMs, tours) also return travel_partners: the booking partners StackTheDeal is connected to, grouped by vertical and linked to the matching section of stackthedeal.com/travel/ — surface those when the user wants to actually book, not just browse deals.

category.description: Optional: only deals in this category, e.g. electronics, home, travel.

max_price.description: Optional: only deals priced at or under this many dollars.

min_discount_pct.description: Optional: only deals at least this percent off (0-100).

offset.description: Pagination: skip this many matches (use the next_offset from the previous result to page further).

sort.description: Sort order: "relevance" (default — best match / catalog order), "price_asc" (cheapest first — use when the user asks for the cheapest), "price_desc" (priciest first), "discount_desc" (biggest percent off first).

store.description: Optional: only deals at this store (exact name, e.g. Amazon).

name: search_deals
title: Search live deals
